questions.explanation: I want to share a time when I disagreed with my manager about the priority of a feature we were building. I believed we should fix a critical bug affecting users, while my manager wanted to ship new features for a marketing deadline. I requested a one-on-one meeting to discuss my concerns calmly. I came prepared with data showing the bug was affecting 20% of our user base and causing churn. Rather than just stating my position, I asked for his perspective and listened first. We discovered he was under pressure from leadership about the launch. I acknowledged that constraint, then suggested a compromise: we could ship a lighter version of the new feature while addressing the bug in a hotfix within the same week. He agreed, and we delivered both on time. This experience taught me the importance of separate ego from the issue, coming with solutions rather than just objections, and finding common ground by understanding the other person's constraints. We ended up having a much stronger working relationship afterward.

## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to map cross-functional incentives, negotiate without formal authority, and coordinate across remote, time-zone-distributed teams. Tests practical steps to gain buy-in and drive adoption with measurable outcomes.

## Key Concepts

- Stakeholder mapping across functions
- Negotiation with limited formal authority
- Remote collaboration and time-zone logistics
- Artifact creation: RACI, rollout plan, success metrics

## Code Example

```javascript
// Example artifact sketch: stakeholder map
const map = [
  {name:'Eng', incentive:'reduce overhead', levers:['shorten review cycles']},
  {name:'PM', incentive:'ship fast', levers:['milestone-based reviews']},
  {name:'UX', incentive:'quality design', levers:['design tokens']},
  {name:'Legal', incentive:'compliance', levers:['policy alignment']},
];
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle a stakeholder who refuses to participate?
- What metrics would you track to show ROI of standardized reviews?

This question probes advanced conflict resolution, stakeholder negotiation, and feedback processes in production-critical systems.

## Key Concepts

- Stakeholder mapping and influence
- Trade-off analysis for SLA impact
- Phased rollout and rollback planning
- Post-change feedback and accountability

## Code Example

```javascript
// Simple helper to model a trade-off decision
function decideTradeOff(options, weights) {
  // options: [{name, score}] with computed scores
  return options.sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score)[0];
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle a deadlock between stakeholders with equal influence?
- How do you ensure durable feedback loops after a production change?
